1.4.URODYNAMIC

multichannel filling and voiding cytometry.

⇨Don’t perform before SUI surgery or stress.

predominance mixed incontinence.

⇨Offer before SUI surgery if:
-Urge predominance.
-Unclear type.
-Apical/ anterior prolapse.
-Voiding dysfunction.
-Failed previous surgery.
⇨Failed Medical Treatment with UI or before surgery.

Urodynamic Testing :

Pre requisites of Urodynamic:

1.Rule out Malignancy of bladder.
2.Rule out UTI.
3.Rule out prolapses.
4.Incontinence affecting QOL.
5.Drugs history.
6.Interpretation of Bladder diary.
7.Informed consent.
8.Formulate all questions that are required for diagnosis
⇨Consent:
-Informed consent regarding procedure.
-Pts expectations of treatment.
-S/E.
-Imperfect predictive value.
⇨Preparation:
-Stop antimuscarinic drugs.
-Rule out UTI.

Evidence of UTI – postpone.

⇨Types of incontinence:

On basis of urodynamic;

1.GSI
2.DOA
→Dry DOA.

- frequency.

- Urgency.

- Nocturia.

→Wet DOA.

- UI

⇨Components of urodynamic: std protocol.
1.Uroflowmetry with post void volume.
2.Transurethral cytometry.
3.Pressure flow study.
⇨More complex
1.Video – urodynamics
2.Ambulatory urodynamics

Uroflowmetry:

•1st line.
•Sitting/ standing position.

Three things:

1.Volume of urine passed.
2.Flow rate 15 – 20ml/sec.
3.Residual volume <100ml.

X axis: volume voided

Y axis: flow rate

Cystometry:

Normal cytogram.

1.Bladder Volume = 300 – 600ml. (decrease in OAB & fibrosis)
2.Residual volume <50ml.
3.Flow rate 15 – 20 ml/sec.
4.Flow time 20 sec.
5.detrusor pressure = < 15cm of H2O, Filling phase
6.voiding phase < 70mm of H2O.

 

 

Voiding problems:

-Capacity > 600ml.
-Flow rate < 15 – 20ml/sec.
-Evacuation time .
-PVR >50ml.

Urodynamic SI:

-Same as normal except leakage on Valsalva or abdominal pressure without increasing detrusor pressure.
